name: Student Club Member
definition: A person recorded in the student club roster, carrying identity, contact, role and academic affiliation attributes.
scope: Student club membership analysis; the roster of people the club tracks

name: Event
definition: A club activity scheduled on a date, characterized by a name, a type and a lifecycle status.
scope: Event planning, attendance and budget analysis

name: Attendance Record
definition: A link record asserting that one member attended one event; one row per member-event pair.
scope: Event participation and turnout analysis

name: Event Budget Line
definition: An allocation of money to one spending category for one event, tracking the allocated amount, the amount spent, the amount remaining and the event's status at that time.
scope: Event-level budget tracking by spending category

name: Expense
definition: A single cost incurred for an item on a date, attributed to the member who incurred it and charged against a budget line.
scope: Spending records; each row is one purchased item

name: Income Record
definition: A single inflow of money received by the club on a date, characterized by an amount, a source and free-text notes.
scope: Club revenue and funding source analysis

name: Academic Major
definition: A degree program offered by the university, described by its name and the department and college that host it.
scope: Academic affiliation of members and its institutional levels

name: ZIP Code Area
definition: A postal ZIP code and its assigned geography: the primary city, county and state the ZIP code belongs to.
scope: Address geography derived from a member's ZIP code

name: Member Full Name
definition: The complete personal name of a member, formed by combining the member's given name and family name into one label.
scope: Any request for a member's name, full name or person label

name: Club Position
definition: The role a member holds in the club, ranging from ordinary membership through elected officer roles to inactive status.
scope: Club officer and membership status analysis

name: T-Shirt Size
definition: The apparel size recorded for a member for club merchandise orders.
scope: Club merchandise sizing analysis

name: Member Contact Number
definition: The telephone number recorded for a member, stored as formatted text in more than one layout.
scope: Looking up or reporting a member's phone number

name: Major Name
definition: The name of a degree program as recorded by the university; the finest academic affiliation level attached to a member.
scope: Filtering members by what they study

name: Academic Department
definition: The administrative department or school within the university that hosts one or more majors.
scope: Aggregating majors at department level

name: Academic College
definition: The broadest academic unit of the university that contains departments and their majors.
scope: Aggregating academic affiliation at college level

name: Event Name
definition: The human-readable label given to a scheduled club activity.
scope: Referring to or filtering events by label

name: Event Status
definition: The lifecycle stage of an event: whether it is still open, still being planned, or finished.
scope: Selecting events by lifecycle stage, e.g. closed events

name: Budget Row Event Status
definition: The status of the event a budget line belongs to, denormalized onto the budget row; expresses the same concept as the event's own status field.
scope: Budget-row-level filtering by event lifecycle stage; a redundant but consistent representation of event status

name: Event Type
definition: The kind of activity an event represents, such as a meeting, a game, a speaker session or community service.
scope: Grouping or excluding events by kind of activity

name: Expense Description
definition: The free-text label naming the item an expense paid for; the kind of expense incurred.
scope: Identifying what money was spent on

name: Expense Date
definition: The calendar date on which an expense was incurred, recorded as an ISO date string.
scope: Time-based filtering and grouping of spending

name: Expense Month
definition: The calendar month of an expense, obtained from the month component of the expense date; used to group spending by month.
scope: Monthly spending analysis such as September and October totals

name: Budget Category
definition: The spending classification a budget line allocates money to, such as advertisement, food or parking; it also classifies the expenses charged to that line.
scope: Budget and expense analysis by spending category

name: Income Source
definition: The origin of money received by the club, such as member dues, fundraising, sponsorship or a school appropriation.
scope: Revenue breakdown by funding origin

name: Expense Approval Flag
definition: A text flag recording whether an expense was approved by the club.
scope: Filtering or summing approved expenditures

name: City
definition: The primary place name assigned to a ZIP code by the postal service.
scope: City-level geography analysis over the ZIP code reference data

name: County
definition: The county or county-equivalent that contains a ZIP code's area.
scope: County-level geography analysis such as counting cities within a county

name: State
definition: The US state or territory a ZIP code belongs to; the coarsest geography level in the reference data.
scope: State-level geography analysis such as members from a given state

name: Allocated Budget Amount
definition: The amount of money budgeted for a spending category of an event.
scope: Comparing allocations against realized spending

name: Budget Spend
definition: The realized amount of money spent against a budget line, equal to the total cost of the expenses charged to that line.
scope: Measuring how much was actually spent per budget line or event

name: Remaining Budget
definition: The portion of a budget line's allocation that is still unspent; it becomes negative when spending exceeds the allocation.
scope: Detecting budget exhaustion and over-spending

name: Expense Cost
definition: The monetary amount of a single expense item.
scope: Individual expense amounts, totals and averages

name: Income Amount
definition: The monetary amount received in a single income record.
scope: Totalling club revenue

name: Attendance Count
definition: The number of members who attended an event, measured as the number of attendance records for that event.
scope: Event turnout measurement and turnout thresholds

name: Spend-to-Budget Ratio
definition: The proportion of a budget line's allocation that has been consumed by spending, expressed as spend divided by allocated amount.
scope: Comparing how fully different budget lines or events used their allocations

name: Average Expense Cost
definition: The mean monetary value of expense items within a chosen grouping of expenses.
scope: Comparing an individual expense against typical spending

name: Budget Overrun
definition: The extent to which spending exceeded a budget line's allocation, i.e. the magnitude of a negative remaining balance.
scope: Ranking budget lines or events by how far they exceeded their allocation
